verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says the Search API or Sonar ranks results by meaning rather than keywords. It only describes "ranked web results" with filtering. The only semantic-search mention is an embeddings endpoint "for semantic search and RAG pipelines". That is a building block a developer would use to construct their own semantic search, not a semantic search capability the product runs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run meaning-based semantic search that finds results keyword engines miss
